audit_items.title: Verify Cryptographic Hash Collision Resistance: Is keccak256 in encode_account implementation using a vetted library with no known weaknesses?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: encode_account and its keccak256 usage is an EL (Execution Layer) concept. Prysm is a CL (Consensus Layer) client and does not implement encode_account. The keccak256 found in Prysm (crypto/keystore/keccak256.go) is an unrelated keystore utility.
